  • Habilidade para interpretação de esquemas elétricos e manuseio de equipamentos de laboratório (osciloscópio, multímetro, analisador lógico);

Descrição da empresa

A Electro Aço Altona S.A. foi fundada em 8 de março de 1924 como uma pequena fundição e oficina de reparos mecânicos. Foi inicialmente chamada Auerbach & Werner, fruto da junção dos nomes dos proprietários de origem alemã: o engenheiro Paul Werner e o ferreiro Ernst Auerbach. A empresa cresceu e incorporou o aço em sua linha de produção, mudando o seu nome para Electro Aço Altona em 1933. Nasceu assim a primeira fundição de aço de Santa Catarina e uma das primeiras do Brasil.

Ao longo da última década, adquiriu outras empresas para comportar e ampliar sua linha de produção, bem como abriu subsidiárias no exterior para ampliar o suporte aos clientes nas áreas de maior demanda comercial, como Europa e América do Norte.

A Altona progride continuamente, sempre identificando os setores mais aquecidos da economia para ampliar a sua atuação, desenvolvendo novos mercados e fornecendo suas soluções em aço para os mais variados mercados.

title: Head of FP&A - WEEM
description:
Job Description About the Job

We have an excellent opportunity available for a Head of FP&A to make a difference at Kraft Heinz. The role of the Head of FP&A lies within the WEEM region (West and East Emerging markets). You’ll be working in a high performing team, alongside peers always trying to reach the next level. Get ready for a lot of interactions with several stakeholders in the markets as well as exposure to the Senior leadership team of the company. A very dynamic and fast-moving environment incorporating a 360 view of the business.

Job summary

As the Head of FP&A, you will play a critical role in driving financial planning and analysis for our company. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to provide strategic insights and recommendations that support business decisions and drive financial performance.

A key success factor for this role is the ability to lead complex process planning projects involving multiple stakeholders across different geographies and time zones. Strong communication, organizational skills, and the ability to influence and guide diverse teams—even those more senior than yourself—are essential. While technical expertise is highly valued, success in this role comes from combining analytical strength with the ability to collaborate effectively and align stakeholders toward common goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead planning and analysis for the zone, including monthly and annual business cycles (Strategic plan / annual budget).

  • Own P&L, Cash forecasting and Zero‑Based Budgeting (ZBB); drive the monthly close and forecasting cadence to deliver timely, accurate results. Collaborate with Accounting & Financial controlling to ensure accurate financial reporting, controls and month‑end close activities.

  • Develop and maintain driver‑based financial models and scenario analyses to support decision‑making.

  • Partner with business and functional leaders to define, monitor and report on KPIs; deliver actionable variance analysis and recommendations.

  • Elevate financial storytelling and executive communications for leadership forums and steering committees.

  • Lead transformation initiatives with Global FP&A and GBS to simplify processes, increase automation and advance analytics adoption.

  • Prepare business cases and ad‑hoc analysis to support senior leadership and strategic initiatives.

  • Coach country FP&A leads; establish common standards, governance and a data‑driven decision framework across the zone.

  • Manage and develop a high‑performing FP&A team (4 direct reports).

  • Drive cross‑functional process planning projects, ensuring alignment among stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones. Communicate clearly, organize effectively, and lead with influence to deliver results in complex, matrixed environments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or related field;

  • 7+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, preferably in a corporate setting.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

  • Advanced proficiency in financial modelling and Microsoft Excel.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with proven ability to lead and influence diverse stakeholders across regions and seniority levels.

  • Proven track record of driving financial performance and identifying areas for improvement.

Location(s): São Paulo - Eldorado

description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

PLEASE SUBMIT ALL RESUMES/CV'S IN ENGLISH FOR CONSIDERATION

Language Requirement: Fluent Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Preferred Experience: Pharmaceutical/Biotech Industry, Hematology, Oncology.

Location: Sao Paulo.

General Description

BeOne Medicines (“BeOne”) is a rapidly growing, global commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing innovative molecularly targeted and immuno-oncology drugs for the treatment of cancer.

Senior Legal Counsel – Latin America

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel in Latin America whose key responsibility is to serve as a legal advisor and business partner to the General Managers (GM) of Brazil, LATAM and Mexico & Central America and the members of their Leadership Team. The Senior Counsel will provide legal expertise in contracts, employment law, and other ad-hoc support in Latin America, as well as in other markets, depending on workload capacity in Latin America. The ideal candidate will have prior experience counseling prescription pharmaceutical companies in Latin America, specifically advising prescription drug companies on legal issues related to the launch and commercialization of new pharmaceutical products, as well as matters concerning marketing, promotion, advertising, scientific exchange, interactions with healthcare professionals and employment law within the LATAM region.

The position requires native-level proficiency and/or fluency in Portuguese, Spanish and English.

Essential Functions
  • Attend and actively contribute to discussions and decisions at the affiliates Leadership Team meetings, providing sound and highly responsive legal and business partner support.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on Latin America healthcare laws and related business operations, staying abreast of evolving local healthcare legislation and regulations.
  • Advise business colleagues on various initiatives to advance the Company’s strategy while addressing legal risks and protecting BeOne’s integrity and reputation.
  • Provide local and regional legal advice on promotion, market access, pricing and reimbursement, employment, the use of social media, dissemination of scientific information, product liability, competition, and other matters relevant to the development, regulatory approval, and commercialization of prescription drugs.
  • Serve as a “wise counsel,” offering good judgment and practical legal solutions to challenges faced by BeOne in Latin America, maintaining a thoughtful risk-taking mindset in all areas of the Life Sciences industry.
  • Draft, negotiate, and manage a high volume and wide variety of complex contracts. This includes the review and revise employment agreements, consulting agreements, and HR-related contracts.
  • Develop local policies, procedures, and processes for Latin America adapted from global SOPs that ensure compliance with local laws, regulations, and codes while driving consistency. Conduct training as needed.
  • Build relationships and influence at all organizational levels, demonstrating a flexible approach to connect with colleagues across the broader organization and engage with multiple stakeholders to drive projects and cultural change.
  • Provide practical, solution-oriented legal support to BeOne internal clients during contract preparation and negotiation. Train and educate local and regional stakeholders on the use of contract templates, relevant legal issues, and best contracting practices.
  • Manage external counsel effectively, build effective relationships, and monitor legal spending.
  • Exhibit excellent verbal and written communication skills, developing and providing clear direction to the business and pragmatic solutions to complex legal and compliance challenges.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and self-confidence to identify, assess, and mitigate legal and compliance risks, delivering effective recommendations on diverse legal and business matters.
  • Generate reports, presentations, spreadsheets, memos, and other documents for the Legal and Compliance Department, internal/external clients, and the senior management team as requested.
  • Complete special projects and responsibilities as requested in Europe and the New Markets regionli>
  • Provide expert legal guidance on employment matters, including hiring, terminations, compensation/benefits, union relations, contingent workers, safety and health requirements, performance management, internal investigations, and leave of absences across various LATAM countries. Advise and implement proactive strategies for labor risk prevention and compliance with local labor codes.
  • Handle and resolve disputes and claims including pre-litigation and litigation disputes and government audits. Assist in internal investigations related to employment issues.
  • Monitor pending and new laws, regulations, decisions and government enforcement activities, also in those related to employment issues, and provide proactive, strategic advice to relevant stakeholders.
  • Conduct periodic meetings or “office hours” for HR/Payroll to meet with internal and external counsel, as needed, to resolve HR issues more effectively and efficiently. Work closely with the Assistant General Counsel, Americas Employment, who will be a supportive, advisory manager, to allow collaborative oversight on employment-related issues.
Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience
  • Brazilian law degree, with strong experience in advising on Brazilian laws governing pharmaceutical companies.
  • 7+ years of experience, preferably including both in a law firm and in-house in the biopharmaceutical industry.
Other Experience
  • Native-level fluency or fluency in Portuguese, Spanish and English required. Additional European language skills are an advantage.
  • Experience advising on and strong and up to date knowledge of Latin America medicines/biopharmaceutical laws, regulations, codes of practice and best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience gained within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry and/or significant law firm experience advising clients within the life sciences sector, including with the launch of new pharmaceutical products.
  • A demonstrated ability to collaborate, as well as to work independently, balancing competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with a high level of professionalism.
  • Highly effective communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Detail-oriented.

title: Teamkoordinator – maling og montage
description:
Får du et personligt kick af at du og dit team lykkes? Går du gerne forrest, har et godt overblik og kan motivere andre?

Vil du have nye udfordringer, hvor du både kan bruge dine hænder og din evne til at motivere andre? Så er du måske Maskinfabrikken JST’s nye teamkoordinator til afdelingen for maling og montage.

JST er en 100% dansk producent af skovle og redskaber til landbrug og entreprenørbranchen. Hos os er sammenhold og humor i hverdagen nøgleord – og vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på holdet!

Oversigt

Som teamkoordinator har du ansvaret for, at afdelingens opgaver udføres effektivt, sikkert og med høj kvalitet.

  • Ophængning, afvaskning og klargøring af emner til maling
  • Maling med 2K-elektrostatisk anlæg
  • Tørring i tørreovn
  • Montage (primært hydraulik)
  • Klargøring og pakning til forsendelse

Vi investerer løbende i ny teknologi, og har som et led i vores vækststrategi allokeret et nyt område til en moderne semi-automatisk malerlinje, som du får en central rolle i at indkøre og optimere.

Som teamkoordinator kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med produktionslederen.

Det bliver dit ansvar at lede, vejlede og motivere afdelingens 3 medarbejdere, samt fremme et godt samarbejde og arbejdsmiljø i teamet.

Ansvar og arbejdsopgaver

Som teamkoordinator skal du sikre, at dagsplanen gennemføres i en optimal rækkefølge set ud fra deadlines, levering, flow og opgavens kompleksitet. Det er ligeledes dit ansvar at sikre personalets effektivitet og produktivitet, samt have fokus på kvalitetssikring og sørge for at procedurer og processer løbende optimeres og forbedres.

Du leder ved at gå forrest og det er dit ansvar hver dag at sikre en god opstart og at dagens afsendelse (produktion) er klar til aftalt deadline 13.45 til kvalitetstjek. I det daglige arbejde skal du rundt til medarbejderne min. 3-4 gange og har desuden ansvaret for, at alt er korrekt nedlukket og klargjort efter dagens arbejde for at sikre en effektiv opstart dagen efter.

Du indgår desuden i afdelingens arbejde sammen med dine 3 medarbejdere. Du er der hvor der er mest brug for din indsats! Om morgenen vil du typisk arbejde sammen med klargøringsmanden om ophæng af produkter til malekabinen, derefter vil der være nedtagning af emner fra malekabinen og montage af produkter. Op ad dagen, når ordrerne bliver færdige, pakkes de til afsendelse.

Du har et medansvar for egen faglig udvikling og for proaktivt og opsøgende at ajourføre din egen viden samt dele din viden med kollegerne i teamet, og har desuden et ansvar for at nye medarbejdere følger en introplan for korrekt oplæring.

Der kan være flere veje ind i stillingen, men vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra et tilsvarende job
  • Gerne kendskab til og/eller interesse i montage og maleprocesser
  • Har god kvalitetssans og forstår vigtigheden af rettidig levering
  • Har indsigt og interesse i produktionsflow
  • Taler dansk og kan kommunikere forståeligt på engelsk

Som teamkoordinator får du et personligt kick af at du og dit team lykkes, og finder det naturligt at gå forrest og tage ejerskab.

Du er en synlig leder med mod og gennemslagskraft, der stiller krav til både sig selv og andre. Og du er villig til at investere den tid det tager at få opgaverne løst.

Du er ordholdende, ansvarlig, struktureret og har et godt overblik, og kan skabe holdånd og motivere andre. Du trives i et travlt miljø og kan bevare ro og fokus – også når der er tryk på - og bidrager med fleksibilitet, energi og godt humør.

Virksomheden tilbyder
  • Et alsidigt job, hvor du kan sætte dit præg på afdelingens udvikling
  • En uformel arbejdsplads med 65 engagerede kollegaer
  • En virksomhed i vækst, der prioriterer trivsel og kollegaskab
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer, sundhedsforsikring, pension, vaskeordning og personaleforening
Yderligere oplysninger/henvendelse

Henvendelser vil blive behandlet løbende.

Tiltrædelse: hurtigst muligt.

Hos Maskinfabrikken JST A/S laver vi skovle og redskaber til entreprenørbranchen og landbruget.

Vi er en økonomisk solid virksomhed i vækst, og vi har for nyligt udvidet fabrikken, så vi står med en fuldt udstyret, moderne fabrik. Alle vores produkter bliver lavet på fabrikken i Lem St. Derfor har vi fuld kontrol over kvaliteten og produktionsprocessen.

Du bliver en del af holdet med ca. 65 erfarne og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere. Vi er jordnære, ærlige og omgængelige – og vi har et godt sammenhold med tid til smil og god værkstedshumor. Vi har overenskomst med Dansk Industri og har et godt samarbejde med Dansk Metal og 3F.

title: Director
description:
About This Role

The Director, LATAM Country and Site Operations (CSO) provides leadership and operational oversight for Country and Site Operations in Latin America, including Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru. The position oversees a high‑performing regional Country and Site Operations team, comprising Country Clinical Sciences Leads (CCSLs), Clinical Research Monitors (CRAs), and Clinical Monitoring Leads (CMLs), which includes both Full‑Time Employees (FTEs) and Functional Service Providers (FSPs). The CSO develops and implements region‑specific strategies to optimize trial delivery and operational performance while ensuring compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and local regulatory requirements.

This role strengthens Biogen’s presence in Latin America by building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, investigators, site staff, regulatory bodies, and patient organizations. The Director CSO also acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), representing the Country and Site Operations function during the development and execution of global initiatives.

What You’ll Do Operational Leadership
  • Provide operational leadership and oversight of Country and Site Operations across the LATAM region.
  • Develop and implement specific operational strategies to optimize clinical trial delivery, operational performance, and resource allocation across Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru.
  • Deliver proactive operational intelligence on regional regulatory and clinical trial environments to guide country and site selection strategies and enhance trial planning.
Operational Management
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of clinical trials in the LATAM region, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Ensure compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and local and international regulations governing clinical trial conduct.
  • Monitor quality metrics, operational performance, and trial progress, implementing corrective actions when necessary to maintain excellence.
Team Leadership and Development
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing regional Country and Site Operations team, including CCSLs, Clinical Project Managers, Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), CRMs, and CMLs (both FTEs and FSPs).
  • Assist in recruiting new staff and ensure staff retention and turnover rates remain within expected levels.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and professional growth among team members.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, investigators, site staff, regulatory bodies, and patient organizations, to strengthen Biogen’s presence in Latin America.
  • Represent Biogen at local industry, scientific, and patient organization meetings, advocating for the company’s clinical programs and fostering external partnerships.
  • Facilitate effective engagement with Key Medical Experts (KMEs) in collaboration with affiliate personnel to ensure alignment with clinical and business strategies.
Global Alignment and SME Representation
  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), representing Country and Site Operations in the review and execution of global initiatives.
  • Provide global teams with detailed regional operational and scientific knowledge from engagements.
  • Ensure thoughtful integration of local opportunities and needs into global strategies.
Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a deep understanding of clinical operations and trial delivery. You thrive in dynamic environments and have excellent interpersonal skills that allow you to build strong relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders. Your ability to mentor and develop teams fosters collaboration and accountability, driving operational excellence. You are passionate about making a meaningful impact on the company’s presence in Latin America and are adept at representing the organization on a global stage.

Qualifications
  • University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required; advanced/graduate degree preferred.
  • 12+ years’ experience in clinical development, experience across multiple clinical operations disciplines including field‑based site‑facing clinical operations roles, clinical trial delivery via an outsourcing model.
  • Deep understanding of the LATAM Clinical Trial environment.
  • Ability to collaborate cross functionally.
  • Experienced people manager.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory environment regarding GCP, clinical trial regulations and regulatory guidances pertinent to clinical trial conduct in assigned region.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including experience working with various levels of senior management.
  • Fluent in English.
Preferred Qualifications
  • R&D project leadership experie

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Your Career

We’re looking for an exceptional marketing executive who can lead our LATAM Marketing organization through Palo Alto Network’s next phase of growth and AI transformation. The Sr. Director of LATAM Marketing will report to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). We are seeking a strategic marketer who is also an inspirational leader with passion, authenticity, great communication skills, and a track record of building strong cross‑functional relationships while driving outstanding business results. Are you a sales‑oriented, customer‑obsessed marketing leader with deep business acumen and disruptive thinking who can lead through change to consistently deliver on aggressive growth targets? If so, this may be the role for you!

Your Impact
  • Create the LATAM demand generation plan that aligns with strategic growth initiatives, optimizes regional marketing mix, and maximizes ROI.
  • Accelerate business growth through innovative omni‑channel strategies including account based marketing, field marketing, partner marketing, and digital programs that are focused on the end‑to‑end customer journey to deliver on pipeline and bookings targets.
  • Hire, develop, and retain a high‑performing team of marketers who are able to respond quickly to shifts in the marketplace, disrupt the competition, and blaze new trails with modern, data‑driven marketing programs.
  • Partner closely with sales leadership and additional key stakeholders to drive thought leadership, deepen relationships with CxOs and other decision makers, acquire new logos, and accelerate platform consolidation with existing customers.
  • Build a highly effective regional marketing operation that scales efficiently, maintains focus on top business priorities, enhances the customer experience, and ensures brand consistency across every touch point.
Your Experience
  • Over ten years of marketing leadership experience in technology, inspiring teams to do their best work, establishing strong cross‑functional relationships, and delivering results at scale.
  • Subject matter expert with deep understanding of marketing‑sourced pipeline creation strategies, tactics and conversion metrics, and a commitment to innovation and growth.
  • Strong track record of driving marketing excellence, setting clear goals aligned with business priorities, exceeding targets, and developing leaders.
  • Ability to break through organizational boundaries, foster strong partnerships with key stakeholders, quickly adapt to shifts in the market, and influence executive leaders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business or technology, MBA preferred.
The Team

Step into a marketing role at Palo Alto Networks, where your innovation drives global impact against escalating cyber threats in this era of AI. You'll seize the unique opportunity to develop cutting‑edge strategies and compelling content while collaborating with industry‑leading experts in the fast‑paced cybersecurity landscape. Here, your creativity directly contributes to a safer digital future for everyone, fostering your growth and development in this ever‑evolving environment.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Our Experian Software Solution's Analytics Services Team supports analytic and generative AI products for decisioning, analytics, and fraud and identity globally.

As a Senior Data Scientist , you will help develop analytical solutions and contribute to product prototypes using your predictive modeling skills, coding expertise, and Gen AI experience. You will apply analytic consulting skills to lead client and internal engagements for Experian's new global product launches and early client success efforts. You will report to the Director of Data Science and Gen AI.

What you'll do:
  • Create advanced machine learning analytical solutions and prototypes to extract insights from diverse structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Research, and Data Science teams in the design of Machine Learning, Dashboarding, Ad Hoc Analysis and AI applications. We implement these applications in a cloud-native big data (AWS) computing platform.
  • Articulate model processes and outcomes, documenting and presenting findings and performance metrics, and translating complex findings into relevant insights.
  • Partner with Leaders, Analytic Consultants, Engineers, Account Executives, Product Managers, and external partners to bring new solutions to market that provide impact to Experian's broad client base.
  • Use Gen AI and model development tools to develop new models.
  • Research and integrate new data assets from different sources into Experian's ML and AI platform. Develop and assess analytic tools developed internally and externally.
  • Gather feedback from internal and external clients to guide new product development, feature prioritization, and product evolution of tools and capabilities supported by the Ascend Platform.
  • Dissect and document vast datasets, analyzing them to highlight patterns and insights.
  • Solve complex challenges by developing impactful algorithms.
  • Gather input from colleagues and management to address issues within project team.
  • Lead and advocate efforts to improve client's analytical solution, data quality, model fit, and project timeline.
  • Work with the product management team to provide expert advise and define the go-to-market strategy for new products and services based on the new data science models/ methodologies.
  • Participate in the greater analytical community through conference presentation and white paper.
About Experian

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to accomplish their financial goals and help them save time and money.

We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more industry segments.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland.

Experience and Skills What you'll bring:
  • Advanced degree in Machine Learning, Data Science, AI, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • 4+ years of experience in AI, data science, or predictive modeling, with a track record for managing complex, hands‑on analytical technology projects.
  • Statistical modeling proficiency in at least one programming language, with coding skills in Python, and familiarity with coding best practices.
  • Experience with large data analysis using Spark (pySpark preferred).
  • Experience with LLMs and the relevant tools in the Generative AI domain.
  • Experience with ML algorithms (e.g., XGBoost, GANs, clustering, graph algorithms, hyperparameter tuning).
  • Experience with open‑source tools for deep learning and machine learning technology such as PyTorch, Keras, TensorFlow, scikit‑learn, pandas.
  • Experience applying Generative AI‑based tools.
  • Experience with Hadoop and NoSQL related technologies such as Map Reduce, Hive, HBase, MongoDB, and Cassandra.
  • Experience modifying and applying advanced algorithms to address practical problems.
  • Fluent English – written and spoken.
Additional Information You will get:
  • Personal Development – career pathway for professional growth supported by learning and development programs and unlimited access to online educational training courses, learning materials and books.
  • Work environment – excellent work conditions with friendly environment, recognized team spirit, and fun and quality recreation time.
  • Social benefit package including life insurance, food vouchers, additional health insurance, monthly flex allowance and internet coverage, corporate discounts, marriage and childbirth / adoption allowance, Multisport card, Sharesave plan, Employee assistance program, a birthday gift and many other benefits!
  • Work‑life balance – 25 days paid vacation, 1 additional day off for your birthday and extra 3 paid days for participation in Social responsibility event.
  • Opportunity for Flexible working hours and Home Office.

Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

  • Disseminar padrões técnicos, boas práticas e conhecimento por meio de documentação estruturada e mentorias técnicas.

Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência. Entendemos que iniciativas com foco em vagas preferenciais contribuem para avanços na criação de um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, inovador e atrativo para novos talentos. Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Na Vale, contribuímos para a formação de futuros. Da mineração, do planeta e o seu. Oferecemos oportunidades para diversas áreas e objetivos profissionais. Aqui, nossos talentos constroem juntos um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo que valoriza a pessoa como ela é: sua individualidade, seu protagonismo e comprometimento. Na Vale, aprendemos juntos. Acreditamos na riqueza das experiências do dia a dia e na troca de conhecimento entre os talentos. Aqui, todo momento pode e deve ser um aprendizado. Na Vale, também crescemos juntos. Estabelecemos relações sólidas e de valor compartilhado com os nossos empregados e a sociedade. Assim, demonstramos nosso comprometimento com um legado positivo, resultados consistentes e com a construção de uma mineração com processos mais inovadores e sustentáveis: a mineração do futuro. Onde tem futuro, a Vale está.

Política de Diversidade

Acesse e conheça também nossa Política de Diversidade.

A Vale não realiza nenhum tipo de cobrança para participação em nenhuma etapa dos seus processos seletivos . title: Marketing Project Leader - Life Sciences
description:
Ready to leverage your scientific expertise to contribute to the growth and visibility of a global leader in preclinical research?

QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the B2B communication and marketing strategy targeting pharma and biotech sponsors, positioning our services as key partners in analytical and clinical development for both branded and generic drugs on the Brazilian and international markets.

We are seeking a scientifically driven professional, eager to grow into a strategic role at the crossroads of marketing, scientific communication, and business development.

Reporting to the Marketing & Communication Director, Life Sciences, you will be the marketing and scientific lead for Brazil. You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and R&D teams, as well as with external partners (agencies, designers, freelancers).

Responsibilities
  • Develop and manage your area: define the marketing strategy with the Marketing Director, Managing Director Brazil, and Heads of Pharma and Cosmetics; plan, implement, and monitor marketing actions and performance.

  • Support the sales team: develop sales tools, training materials, and presentations.
  • Inbound marketing: manage web pages (PT/EN), write SEO‑optimized articles, produce newsletters and email campaigns, and contribute to lead generation.

  • Event organization: coordinate participation in conferences and trade shows; build a network of KOLs and strategic partners.
Qualifications
  • MSc (or higher) in Life Sciences (Pharmacy, Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry); PhD is a plus.
  • 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B marketing/communication within pharma, biotech, medtech, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong understanding of the drug development process and clinical research.
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish required.
  • Proficiency in content creation and B2B CRM tools; knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and regulatory awareness.
Desired Profile
  • Autonomous and proactive, capable of driving a market segment.
  • Rigorous and results‑oriented, with strong organizational skills.
  • Creative and forward‑thinking.
  • Curious about scientific and market trends.
  • A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Motivated by innovation and growth in an international environment.

title: Supervisor de Faturamento - AESC Porto Alegre - RS Full-time employee
description:
Se você se identifica com a área de faturamento hospitalar e quer fazer a diferença em uma Instituição com mais de 4 mil pessoas atuando nas áreas de saúde, educação e responsabilidade social, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Responsável por supervisionar e organizar os processos de faturamento, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, normas e diretrizes estabelecidos pela gestão. Atua diretamente na liderança da equipe, acompanhando rotinas, conferências, envio de contas e controle de indicadores.

Requisito obrigatório:

✔ Experiência comprovada em faturamento SUS (SIH/SUS, SIA/SUS, análise de contas, conferência e envio).

Desejável vivência na área da saúde/hospitalar e experiência com gestão de equipe..

O Supervisionar de Faturamento é responsável por supervisionar os processos de faturamento, organizando as atividades juntamente com a equipe, com o objetivo de cumprir a entrega do faturamento dentro dos prazos e normas estabelecidos pela gestão.

  • Organizar as atividades e rotinas de faturamento juntamente com a equipe, através do mapeamento das necessidades do setor;
  • Acompanhar as pendencias de outros setores, a fim de evitar o acúmulo de prontuários, interagindo com os responsáveis das áreas;
  • Apresentar para a gerência os resultados do setor, mediante relatórios e indicadores previamente estabelecidos pelo Gestor;
  • Garantir o fechamento de todas as altas hospitalares, mediante acompanhamento diário de relatórios do sistema de gestão;
  • Executar o faturamento das contas hospitalares e ambulatoriais através da realização de conferência dos prontuários e demais documentos pertinentes ao atendimento do paciente, bem como a auditoria administrativa;
  • Realizar a conferência dos arquivos transmitidos, através de acesso ao portal da saúde, sanando críticas e rejeições;
  • Organizar as atividades e rotinas de pré-faturamento juntamente com a equipe;
  • Promover uma boa comunicação entre as áreas envolvidas no processo de faturamento;
  • Realizar treinamento com as equipes e disseminar o conhecimento.
  • Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão Hospitalar ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência na área hospitalar;

Horário de trabalho:

  • Das 08:00 às 18:00 - Segunda a sexta-feira
  • Vale refeição;
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed
  • Seguro de vida;
Gente & Desenvolvimento

Fundada em 1962, a AESC tem sua origem na Congregação das Irmãs Missionárias de São Carlos Borromeo-Scalabrinianas, presentes no Rio Grande do Sul desde 1915, e que aqui se estabeleceram com o propósito de acolher e cuidar, de modo particular, pessoas migrantes fragilizadas na sua condição socioeconômica e cultural, desde seus países e localidades de origem.

Hoje somos mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras nos segmentos de educação, saúde e responsabilidade social.

Nossa unidade de responsabilidade social está presente na cidade de Caxias do Sul, com o Centro de Atendimento ao Migrante.

Nossas unidades de educação estão presentes nas cidades de Farroupilha, Colégio Nossa Senhora de Lourdes, em Caxias do Sul, Colégio São Carlos, e em Santa Vitória do Palmar, Colégio São Carlos.

E nossas unidades de saúde estão presentes nas cidades de Porto Alegre, com hospitais e serviços de referência no RS e no Brasil, Hospital Mãe de Deus, Hospital Santa Ana e Centros de Atenção Psicossocial e na cidade de Capão da Canoa o Hospital Santa Luzia.
